reviewScope: Canopus records with valid shell thickness but placeholder/unknown bearing edge blocking source-confirmed meaningful core-shell pass.
reviewRules: Do not write Firestore updates from this packet.
Find source-backed bearing edge geometry only.
Do not infer edge geometry from shell material, shell construction, line name, shell thickness, hoop type, or era alone.
If evidence only supports generic metal-shell construction, keep records in metal-edge fallback rather than source-confirmed meaningful edge.
If source confirms a shared line-level bearing edge spec, prepare a separate patch plan only after reviewed decisions are approved.
